name: unsafe fn realloc (ptr : * mut u8 , layout : Layout , new_size : usize) -> * mut u8
rule: If `realloc` returns a non-null pointer, ownership of the memory block referenced by `ptr` is transferred to the global allocator.
api: unsafe fn realloc (ptr : * mut u8 , layout : core::alloc::layout::Layout , new_size : usize) -> * mut u8
expression: The supplied DSL cannot express conditional ownership transfer to the global allocator; it has no ownership or post-call state observations.
